text:
alex.m: Hi team — noticed my Feb 28 paycheck looks prorated but the state withholding still used CA full-month rate even though I was remote in OR from Feb 10. net pay is off by ~$180. Anyone seen this before?

lina: @alex.m bummer — did you file a state change in Workday before the run?

alex.m: I updated address on Feb 11 but the relocation form was sent Feb 20 (late). I assumed prorate would use actual days in CA vs OR.

jamie: Payroll runs used the payroll snapshot at cutoff on Feb 15 usually. If the address changed after cutoff it might not have applied. Marcus can confirm.

marcus-payroll: Hey — I see payrun 2026-02-28 processed with employee_address_state=CA in the run export. If there's a midmonth move after cutoff the run uses the prior state. We can do an off-cycle to correct withholding, but will need approval.

alex.m: Is the correction an off-cycle net adjustment or a W-2 box change? I want to avoid duplicate tax withholdings.

marcus-payroll: We'll do a corrective payroll to refund the excess state withholding and rewithhold OR tax for the actual days if material. On W-2 it will net out as taxable wages & withholding adjustments — no separate W-2 required if corrected before year-end, but we will issue a W-2c if needed after year close.

payroll-bot: payrun 2026-02-28 processed by ADP - batch id pr_62234 - status: posted.

lina: For process: we need (1) employee confirmation of move date, (2) screenshot of address change in Workday, (3) approval from manager for off-cycle. Marcus — can you estimate timeline?

marcus-payroll: If we get approvals today we can schedule an off-cycle next Tues. It takes ~2 business days to reflect in bank ACH; however state tax agencies may show withheld amounts immediately on employer filings.

alex.m: Confirming move date was Feb 10. Attached screenshot in ticket. Manager @jamie approved.

jamie: Approved for off-cycle. Please proceed.

marcus-payroll: Creating ticket now — payroll ticket #PR-8942. I'll post the adjustment detail here once queued.

marcus-payroll: Adjustment preview: gross unchanged, state_tax_CA withheld: 45.23 -> refund 45.23, state_tax_OR withheld: 0 -> withhold 38.17 for prorated days (net refund $7.06). File note: reason=midmonth state residency change, source=workday address change 2026-02-11.

alex.m: Thanks — that looks right. Will the refund show as a separate payline?

marcus-payroll: Yes you'll see a one-off line "State Withholding Correction" on the off-cycle stub and a +$7.06 net adjustment. I'll cc benefits/payments team if anything else pops.

lina: Also flagging for people-ops docs — we should add a short note about cutoff vs. address change timing to the relocation checklist to avoid confusion.

jamie: Agreed, small doc update would prevent more tickets.

payroll-bot: ticket PR-8942 created and assigned to marcus-payroll. ETA off-cycle: 2026-03-03.

alex.m: Appreciate it. One small ask — can you confirm whether this affects 401k pre-tax deferral calculation for Feb?

marcus-payroll: Good question — deferrals are based on gross and won't change. Only tax withholding lines are adjusted.

alex.m: Perfect, thanks everyone :slightly_smiling_face:
